title: Week 3 Worklog
content:
Week 3 Objectives: Learn how AWS IAM manages access to AWS resources. Distinguish IAM Users, Groups, Policies, and Roles. Understand the steps for creating users, assigning permissions, and switching roles in the guide. Tasks to be carried out this week: Day Task Start Date Completion Date Reference Material Wednesday - Read the AWS IAM introduction and distinguish the root user from an IAM user.
- Study Users, Groups, Policies, and Roles, including permission management through user groups.
- Read the steps for creating AdminGroup and AdminUser and signing in as an IAM user.
- Learn how to create AdminRole and OperatorUser and grant sts:AssumeRole permission for role switching.
- Read the cleanup instructions for IAM resources used in the lab. 21/10/2026 21/10/2026 Access management with AWS IAM Week 3 Achievements: Distinguished IAM Users, Groups, Policies, and Roles and understood their purposes in access management. Understood how users receive permissions from policies attached to their groups and why the root user should not be used for everyday tasks. Learned the steps for creating users, groups, and roles in the guide. Understood that switching roles provides the role’s permissions during a session and requires appropriate role-switching permissions and a trust relationship. Recognized the need to grant permissions based on actual requirements and remove unused test IAM resources.
